title: Crispy appears from NOWHERE 👀 #shorts
description: Bup and Pim think they're alone in the attic. They're not. #shorts #animation #cartoon #doughbros #funny

beats.en: Is anyone here? Hello? ...Good. Nobody. We're alone.
beats.de: Ist hier jemand? Hallo? ...Gut. Niemand. Wir sind allein.
beats.fr: Il y a quelqu'un ? Allô ? ...Bien. Personne. On est seuls.
beats.it: C'è qualcuno? Ciao? ...Bene. Nessuno. Siamo soli.
beats.pt: Tem alguém aqui? Oi? ...Ótimo. Ninguém. Estamos sozinhos.

beats.en: See? Nothing to be scared of, Pim.
beats.es: ¿Ves? No hay nada que temer, Pim.
beats.de: Siehst du? Nichts, wovor man Angst haben muss, Pim.
beats.fr: Tu vois ? Rien à craindre, Pim.
beats.it: Visto? Niente di cui aver paura, Pim.

beats.en: ...I just wanted to say good night.
